title: 미래국방전략위원회의 설치 및 운영에 관한 규정 / queue:ARTICLE:3:0:00003:part:1/1
title_original: 미래국방전략위원회의 설치 및 운영에 관한 규정
full_text:
Article 3 (Composition of the Committee)
(1) The Committee shall consist of no more than 15 members, including one chairperson and one vice-chairperson. <Amended on December 9, 2025>
(2) The President shall serve as chairperson, and the vice-chairperson shall be a person designated by the President from among members of the Committee. <Amended on December 9, 2025>
(3) The following persons shall be members of the Committee. In commissioning members under subparagraph 3, consideration shall be given to gender: <Amended on December 9, 2025>
1. The Director of the National Security Office;
2. The Minister of National Defense;
3. Persons with extensive expertise or experience in fields related to national defense reform commissioned by the President (hereinafter referred to as "commissioned members").
(4) The Committee shall have one secretary to support its work, who shall be the First Deputy Director of the National Security Office. <Amended on December 9, 2025>
